g.title: work_loop
g.text: The work loop: do the action until its predicate holds; leave the record; wake

g.title: wake
g.text: cairn wake: reads the range since the start record; writes nothing
(outside a project, refs absent, or a command to recover: one line, exit 3)

g.title: waiting
g.text: Waiting: wake prints the escalation's five fields verbatim;
the agent adds nothing and stops; the hooks print it and do not nag

g.title: reply
g.text: reply SLUG (after ask): append the explanation
done := a reply record names the escalation

g.title: stop
g.text: Done: a done record exists and nothing waits;
the unread queue is rendered; stop.
(With a backlog item waiting, wake names promote instead.)

g.title: answer
g.text: (the agent never does; signed when settings name a key)

g.title: actions
g.text: the named file reads under its grammar; nothing else changed
an interrupted multi-store command's writes are complete, finished from the state on disk
refs/cairn/in-progress (the agent's action record) is gone; the action finished or was abandoned
a path undeclared at the commit that changed it: a scope record with an ok answer names it, or it is restored to the start snapshot; a later declaration never legalizes it
a fix record names the item and a snapshot that changes no Agreed text or reserved path; REQ has a current passing receipt at or after it
the action record (cairn begin) covers PATH through its target's declared inputs, or PATH is clean
PATH is clean, or the action record covers it
a mechanism definition names REQ (cairn declare)
a current receipt carries a result for REQ: input snapshot tree, definition digest, text digest and execution identity equal now
a current receipt carries pass for REQ; the reviewed list carries REQ bound to the current definition digest with a fail receipt
three attempts without a pass: an escalation concerns REQ before a fourth
the reviewed list carries REQ with the current definition and text digests and a fail receipt; no code changed
an outside record names the item, or an escalation concerns it
a review names the current snapshot and answers every fixed question for every target

cairn brief writes the brief; the agent starts the adversary (on the harness's model, in a worktree from the snapshot) and waits; a report names the same snapshot and the brief, with an attempt against every question
a resolution names finding N of the review, the report or an acceptance, and the snapshot after the fix, or an escalation concerns it
an acceptance at the current snapshot covers the cumulative post-report delta: every resolution accepted, every new finding it raised resolved; a resolution rejected twice escalates; no second report

a realized line in docs/decisions.jsonl names the decision and a snapshot, and the realization check passed: the delta touches no data path, Agreed text, working agreement, reserved path or protected setting
the Done rule holds: cairn done writes the done record (the record is the fact; the queue is rendered by the next invocation)

no commitment is open and a backlog item waits: a promotion record names one item and a decision; the roadmap section names only Agreed requirements; Current: moved; a start record pins the set and its digests

g.title: escalate
g.text: (with the evaluator in route mode and inside its envelope,
it may write the decision or name a capture instead)

g.title: trace
g.text: Leave the record: a code commit on the branch,
